transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I feel drained all the time, like I never have the energy to get through work or even enjoy the things I used to. It's just gotten to the point where I feel like I can't keep going like this.
Have you noticed any changes in your mood or interest in activities you normally enjoy, or is the main issue just the lack of energy?

It's definitely both. My mood feels like a dull, numb heaviness, almost like a gray filter over everything, and I've completely lost interest in soccer, hiking, and cooking for friends. I've even been turning down invites from my friends because I just don't have the energy or interest to show up anymore.
Do you ever feel guilty about not being able to participate in activities or see your friends, or is the lack of interest and energy the predominant feeling?

The lack of energy and interest is definitely the main thing. While I might feel a little bad about turning my friends down, I'm usually just too exhausted to even think about going out. It's more of a complete numbness and detachment than feeling active guilt.
Can you tell me more about when these feelings of numbness and detachment started, and if they seemed to come on gradually or all at once?

These feelings started about two years ago, around the middle of my second year of college. It definitely came on gradually, slowly creeping in while I was juggling part-time data work, classes, and commuting. Since then, that heavy, numb feeling has just persisted and grown.
Have you experienced any periods of significant improvement in your mood and energy levels since these symptoms started two years ago, or have they been consistently present?

No, there haven't really been any periods where it got better. This heavy, drained feeling has been there pretty much continuously for a little over two years now, and it has never really lifted. It just feels like a constant weight that is always there.

You mentioned that these feelings have been present for over two years without significant improvement, can you tell me if there have been any shorter periods, even a few weeks, where your mood and energy felt almost back to normal before returning to this state?

No, looking back over the last two years, I can't recall a single period—even for just a couple of weeks—where the heaviness actually lifted or my energy felt back to normal. It has just been a constant, uninterrupted grind the entire time.

Have you experienced any distinct episodes of significantly depressed mood that lasted for a shorter period, such as a few weeks or months, followed by periods where you felt somewhat better, or has it been one long, continuous stretch of feeling this way?

It has definitely been one long, continuous stretch of feeling this way, rather than separate episodes. This heavy, drained feeling has been present pretty much constantly for a little over two years now, ever since it started around the middle of my second year of college.

You've mentioned a continuous stretch of feeling this way for over two years, but can you clarify if there have been any subtle variations in the intensity of your symptoms over time, or has it been a relatively consistent level of heaviness and detachment?

It has been a very consistent level of heaviness, with almost no variation at all. It just feels like a steady, continuous baseline of numbness, and that gray filter hasn't really lifted for the last two years.
